publication_source_relationship: Same runtime/build/test inputs as the retained build-input archive, with later editorial documentation and evidence added. Export-time verification must reject changes outside README files and docs/.
archive_identity: The publication archive has its own manifest and checksum; it must not replace or reuse the build-input archive identity.
native_reproducibility: Locked-source rebuild and measured artifact identity, not bit-identical native binary reproducibility.
video_relationship: Accepted video retains an older package identity; see SUBMISSION_CHECKLIST.md.
